## Minimal Synthetic Reproduction

Provide numbered steps, a small fabricated input and the expected/actual result.
Use redacted diagnostics; inspect their contents before attaching them. Never
attach real/production documents, SQLite stores, credentials, personal paths or
private source-system details. KS does not anonymize submitted documents.

## Existing Context

Link an existing issue or relevant backlog item if one exists. State whether this
also reproduces through KS directly or only through Studio Knowledge Assist.

## Before Submitting

- [ ] This is not an undisclosed vulnerability report.
